title: The approval-baseline cache: the card call and the hash call run the checks once

fixture_files.checks/lint.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# kt lint check (counting variant): records each run in build/lint-runs.
mkdir -p build && echo run >> build/lint-runs
status=0
for f in lib/*.txt; do
  n=0
  while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    case "$line" in *TODO*) echo "$f:$n:1: error: [lint/todo] ${f#lib/}: TODO found"; status=1 ;; esac
  done < "$f"
done
exit $status
